changelog.change: Q1 now takes its emitter supply from own VPD, with RUN AND MAIN_LED_OK series base sinks Q14/Q15 and R112 off pullup. D24 SMBJ16A finite-energy VIN clamp; D25 slew-limited negative clamp; D26 local output backstop. No self-enable from output bus. Hard hotplug and powered paralleling remain unqualified.
R2/R3 precision 100k/10k plus R114 510 ohm: on 12.263-12.976V, off 11.365-12.193V. 13.5V at module includes 0.75V cable drop at 3A. Falling >=11.8V is not guaranteed and is explicitly not claimed.
R109 18mOhm WSLP1206R0180FEA: 2.621-2.940A. Screen Tj at 50C ambient 108.2C maximum vs 125C recommendation. Procurement remains open.
AGND_U2 contains U2.5/.17 and analog returns, joined to GND/PGND only through R113 at C82.2; explicit placement and native regression.

R111 6.8k / C83 100nF; full complex PI/boost/buck plant across 13824 sampled corners. External positive capacitance restricted to 0-440uF with documented cable/passive-load bounds; no arbitrary active-rack stability claim.

3A source resource/qualification matrix and full power-reset/epoch tests; repeated autonomous resets FAIL qualification rather than restarting a passing record. STARTED remains volatile and one-shot per powered epoch.
+5V absent; 15V PD R1=56k; TPS552892-Q1 retained; S8.5 STARTED retained; crowbar deferred/open; 20V retarget includes clamp replacements. No tracks, vias or zones added.

S91_input_qualification.cable: 13.5 V at module = 14.25 V source minimum minus 0.75 V cable at 3 A (0.25 ohm loop)
S91_input_qualification.why: Even perfect resistors cannot meet both recommendations: rising<=13 requires divider factor<=13/1.224=10.621; falling>=11.8 requires >=11.8/1.09=10.826. Actual falling minimum is reported, never relabelled 11.8 V.

S91_enable_logic.drive_source: Q1 emitter VPD upstream of D10; never +12V or VIN

published_envelope.load_type: passive resistive small-signal load; no arbitrary negative-impedance active rack guarantee

S91_compensation.method: TI Eq19-23; exact PI (no crossover shortcut), split bank/R109/cable branch, all listed corner products; one-period delay + fsw/10 pole. GEA +/-30% is sensitivity, not a datasheet limit.
S91_compensation.release_test: Bode at VIN corners, bank/rack corners and 0.05A/rating: PM>45 deg, GM>10 dB, no sustained ringing; no-load FPWM and active rack impedances measured separately. Not performed.

S91_startup_qualification.meaning: 3 A source limiting MUST be tested; output CC does not enforce the PD input contract. Energy times are lower bounds, not startup guarantees.

matrix.condition: Cold start, 14.25 V source +0.25 ohm cable, exact 3.00 A constant-current limit; 0/0.44 mF external each rail; 0/15/25/33 W load; both delay corners; log all attempts
matrix.pass: Single attempt: both rail monitors good within 250 ms of first enable; ARMED by 0.90 s; no V3V3/POR reset, no source restart, <=3.00 A steady input; no retry hidden from record

matrix.condition: Same loads with a PD source hard-resetting on >3 A; include 5 V phase and V3V3 fully collapsed to 0 V
matrix.pass: A single hard reset is counted and disqualifies that source/load combination for guaranteed start; no success by discarding earlier failed attempts

matrix.condition: Persistent rail short, uninterrupted source, then manual RESET and separate full power removal/reapplication
matrix.pass: Each power epoch with input held must fault within 0.90 s+2 ms of first enable, hold RUN low until explicit reset, and fault again with short present

matrix.condition: Ten automatic input hard resets every 200 ms while short remains, V3V3 collapsed in each off interval
matrix.pass: Qualification result must be FAIL_REPEATED_POWER_RESET, never a pass from a final successful cycle; fixture latches power OFF on the second autonomous reset

S91_startup_qualification.power_reset_policy: STARTED and FAULT are volatile. Full V3V3/POR loss legitimately clears both; S8.5 one-shot preserved, not falsely advertised as nonvolatile. Automatic retrying sources are outside qualified envelope. Fixture counts epochs and must stop retries; hardware nonvolatile lockout remains absent.

pd_contract.required_adapter: USB PD source with a 15 V / 3 A fixed PDO, i.e. a >= 45 W PDP adapter (a 27 W source offers only 15 V / 1.8 A and will trip or cycle under load); a non-PD or 5 V-only source never turns U5 on

startup_arming.topology: STARTED = U12 A (PRE_N = START_N = NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, RUN), CLR_N = RESET_N, CLK low); TIMER_GO = RUN AND STARTED; ARMED = U11 output

requirements.R1: bounded arming: converters enabled and unarmed only within the U11 delay after the first enable since RESET
requirements.R2: no restart: ARMED rises once per RESET, t_d after the first enable, whatever MAIN_OK/VPD/rails do
requirements.R3: no early arming: never before a genuine converter enable (U5 on with valid status); the PD 5 V phase cannot start it
requirements.R4: fail-safe: after ARMED any bad status > ~1 ms latches FAULT; FAULT keeps RUN low until RESET; OV_N presets FAULT at any time

required: R1 bounded: ARMED within the U11 delay (0.31-0.88 s) of the first converter enable after RESET, and held until RESET/FAULT: the converters can never run unarmed for longer
R2 no restart: nothing a fault can toggle (MAIN_OK, PGOOD, VPD, V20_OK, the rails) restarts or extends the window; only RESET (or a power-on reset) does

R3 no early arming: the window starts only at a genuine converter enable, i.e. U5 on through its own UVLO with valid status; the PD 5 V phase or an intermediate PDO cannot start it, so no threshold below the converter enable point can arm
R4 fail-safe: after ARMED any bad status > ~1 ms latches FAULT; FAULT holds RUN low until RESET; OV_N (U20 guard: +12V and -12V channels) presets FAULT at any time

topology.STARTED: U12 flip-flop A used as a set/reset latch: PRE_N = START_N, CLR_N = RESET_N, CLK = GND (no clock edges), D = V3V3, Q = STARTED (TP19)
topology.START_N: U14 gate 2: NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, RUN, V3V3, V3V3); low once U5 is on with PGOOD and FLT good, its status validated by V20_OK, while RUN. Level-sensitive, so a MAIN_OK that is already high at RESET release (PGOOD deglitch) still starts it; RUN in the gate keeps PRE_N high while RESET clears the latch
topology.TIMER_GO: U13 gate 3 = RUN AND STARTED -> R69/R70 -> U11 SENSE (unchanged divider)
topology.ARMED: U11 RESET output (R71 pull-up) = ARMED directly; it stays high because its input is latched
topology.ANY_BAD: U14 gate 1 = NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, P12_OK, N12_OK, V3V3): S9.0 ties the former P5_OK input high
topology.FAULT: U12 flip-flop B: CLK = ARMED AND BAD_FILTERED (U13 gate 2, R72/C51 + U15), PRE_N = OV_N, CLR_N = RESET_N; RUN = RESET_N AND NOT_FAULT (U5 SHDN; U2 EN = MAIN_OK; U4 via Q1)
topology.parts: no new IC: the spare U14 gate and U12 flip-flop A re-used; S9.0 R83 120k -> 100k (Basic, the 100k line of R2/R6/R14/R16/R17, no new code), TP19 (copper)

V20_OK.role: U5 status-validity floor: masks U5 FLT/PGOOD (MAIN_OK, R63 pull-up) where U5 is below its 4.5 V operating minimum (PD 5 V phase); NOT an input-good threshold
V20_OK.rule: band minimum >= vSafe5V max 5.5 V + 2.0 V and band maximum <= U5 turn-off minimum - 2.0 V
V20_OK.consequence: whenever U5 can be on (VPD >= its 11.37 V turn-off minimum) V20_OK is high, so MAIN_LED_OK = MAIN_OK there and V20_OK can never be the first status to drop; ANY_BAD = NOT(MAIN_LED_OK AND P12_OK AND N12_OK) means "U5 not on with valid status, or a rail below its monitor threshold"
V20_OK.history: S8.5 (20 V input): R83 120k, 9.06-10.96 V. At the 15 V input its maximum sits above the U5 turn-off minimum less 2 V, so S9.0 uses 100k. S8.4 200k / S8.3 220k tripped inside the U5 band (they meant neither "input good" nor "status valid")

replug_por.status: OPEN: the margin is not established; candidate fixes (not implemented in S8.5): C67 4.7 uF (still right of the TLV431 instability region) roughly halves the settle time, or a CT capacitor on U10 lengthens the POR delay (both also change the RESET timing).

reverse_current.decision: ACCEPTED architecture: no series reverse blocking (owner). S9.1 removes the self-enable defect in hardware; that defect is NOT an accepted event.
reverse_current.rule: No powered parallel supplies or unrestricted hotplug. Unpowered/latched-off injection is qualified ONLY under T1 conditions, not a procedural excuse for self-enabling.
reverse_current.finding: FIXED: Q1 emitter is own VPD; base sink requires RUN AND MAIN_LED_OK through Q14/Q15. R112 defaults off. Bus voltage alone cannot enable U4.

conditions: T1-A: no USB input, +/-12.0 and +/-12.6V external bus, 1A source limit, 0.44mF each rail; ramp <=1V/s at 25C, hold 10s; log EN_N relative to -12V, U4 SW, VIN and bus currents
T1-B: same with USB present and FAULT latched/RUN low; verify off-state once MAIN_OK deglitch expires and capture the preceding <=20ms interval
T1-C: only negative rail applied with same bounded slew; repeat rail order

T1-D: inject a positive 1A, <=20ms pulse into VIN (compliance 28V, automatic disconnect), 25/50C, >=200s between pulses. This separately tests D24 energy/clamp; never assume the now-disabled U4 will generate this pulse
pass_criteria: T1-A/C: EN_N minus -12V <=0.11V settled (<=0.5V transient), zero U4 switching; VIN -0.3..1V after 100ms settled; each bus current <10mA after 100ms
T1-B: same EN/switching/current criteria after 20ms; VIN may retain own-input charge, must remain -0.3..28V, not climb from bus power
T1-D: VIN <=28V incl ringing, measured integral(V*I*dt)<=0.52J, clamp current ends by 20ms, no leakage increase >10uA after cooling; normal restart and regulation after RESET
All: automatic overvoltage disconnect at VIN 28V, negative excursion abort at -0.3V (fast comparator, not human reaction). An abort is a FAIL, not a pass.
bench_test.excluded: Hard hotplug, temperatures below25C for D25 forward-drop guarantee, >1A or >20ms sustained injection, and powered parallel supplies require new protection/qualification.

rail_overvoltage.decision: ACCEPTED architecture: no voltage-triggered fuse/crowbar; crowbar vs eFuse deferred/open. S9.1 D26 is a finite-energy transient backstop, not continuous shunt protection.

conditions: T2-A: input16.5V; 0.44mF +0.5A/rail; externally ramp +12V from12 to16.5V at<=1V/ms, <=1A, total injection<=10ms (including ramp), hold<=1ms at16.5V; fixture removes injection automatically after trigger; scope>=100MS/s
T2-B: R8 open at13.5/16.5V input, 3A source; no external C/no load, then0.44mF+0.5A; capture500ms with independent voltage/current abort
T2-C: R14 open, same conditions; no assumed LMR38020 output OVP
T2-D: RUN held low/logic powered, +14.0V and -13.0V external for10min; safely BELOW the minimum guard thresholds; no-trip only refers to OV_N, not RUN
T2-E: at+15.2V / -13.9V a trip is ALLOWED (inside tolerance bands); repeat guaranteed trip at+15.8V / -14.5V with <=1V/ms slew, <=1A source and >=50us hold (record actual waveform)
pass_criteria_this_module: With >=0.5V rail overdrive beyond each measured trip, OV_N low/FAULT set/RUN low <=20us; MAIN LED off. Keep FAULT latched10s after injection removed, reset explicitly only after fault repair

Externally driven rail remains externally driven until fixture removal: NEVER require it off while injection remains. After removal connect1k/1W discharge load; both rails below1V within2s at <=0.44mF external C

T2-B/C: observed positive rail peak<=24.0V and negative magnitude<=24.0V for the500ms capture; positive duration above16V<=100ms with specified1k discharge; D26 pulse energy<=0.10J; normal regulation after repair/RESET

pulse_budget.basis: Finite 1A x 26V x 20ms engineering budget. Datasheet pulse curve screen ~100W at 20ms after 50C derating; 600W rating applies ONLY to 10/1000us. No universal joule rating or continuous 26W claim.

D24.protects: U2 VIN/SW1 42V abs /36V operating; 50V VIN bank and C25/C26 (26+12.6=38.6V); U5 OUT 60V
D24.limitations: Rated clamp is at 25C and specified waveform, not a measured PCB spike bound. Qualified fixture requires VIN<28V incl ringing at 25/50C. Sustained enabled reverse power is NOT safe.

D25.scope: Bus slew <=1 V/s at 25C (<=26.5uA displacement current from 2x10u+100n rated high C). Not a cold/fast-hotplug clamp.

D26.protects: U2 VOUT/SW2/ISP/ISN 25V abs and local 25V MLCCs; not a 16V downstream guarantee
D26.limitations: Finite pulse backstop only; external rail source must be removed by fixture. No fuse coordination / crowbar or sustained shunt claim.
